# Genesis Apocryphon Column 4 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Genesis Apocryphon Column 4 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 4:1 — "went" vs "set out"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Methuselah went" | Literal azal |
| LOGOS | "Methuselah went" | Standard formal |
| PNEUMA | "Methuselah set out" | Dynamic rendering implying purposeful journey |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS "Methuselah went." The simple verb is sufficient; PNEUMA's "set out" adds nuance not present in the Aramaic.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 4:2 — "ends of the earth" vs "farthest reaches"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-ends-of the-earth" | Hyphenated construct chain |
| LOGOS | "the ends of the earth" | Standard formal rendering |
| PNEUMA | "the farthest reaches of the earth" | Dynamic expansion |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "the ends of the earth." Standard biblical phrasing; PNEUMA's "farthest reaches" adds unnecessary elaboration.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 4:7 — "told" vs "related" vs "laid the whole story before"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "he-told him everything" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "he related everything to him" | Formal with narrative verb |
| PNEUMA | "he laid the whole story before him" | Dynamic paraphrase |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "he related everything to him." More polished than EMET; less expansive than PNEUMA.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 4:8 — "asked" vs "inquired" vs "pressed"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "he-asked him for the truth" | Literal she'el |
| LOGOS | "he inquired of him the truth" | Formal elevated register |
| PNEUMA | "he pressed him for the truth" | Dynamic implying urgency |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "he inquired of him the truth of this matter." PNEUMA's "pressed" adds emotional urgency not in the text.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 4:10 — "truly from Lamech" vs "was Lamech truly the father"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "or truly from Lamech" | Literal fragment |
| LOGOS | "or truly from Lamech" | Same as EMET |
| PNEUMA | "or was Lamech truly the father" | Dynamic expansion making meaning explicit |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS "or truly from Lamech." PNEUMA's expansion, while clarifying, adds words not in the fragment.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements: 5*
*Resolution: LOGOS 3, EMET/LOGOS 2, EMET 0, PNEUMA 0, Compromise 0*
